title: A brief that asks a read-only agent to write a file is refused
why: An Explore agent briefed to write a file has no Write tool, so it wrote a scratch file by shell redirect instead.
source: Retrospective 20:41 CST Nov 11 (its own mistake in the prose-wave audit)
note: Ask: agent_brief.py refuses a brief that asks a read-only agent type (Explore, Plan, refuter, reviewer, design-reviewer) to write or save a file. A test goes red on today's code with an Explore brief that says to write a file. Waits for the fan-out (owner 13:51). Lane code-agents started 07:29 CST Nov 12 (coordinator fan-out, Sonnet, medium).
